summary: Shows the vault_encrypted test (2.10+) to check if a variable is an inline vault-encrypted value.
questions: How do I check whether a variable is vault encrypted?

answer_card.title: Testing for vault-encrypted values
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
msg: '{{ (variable is vault_encrypted) | ternary("Vault encrypted", "Not vault encrypted") }}'
```

Available since 2.10 for inline single `!vault` values.
